description: Query Ensembl BioMart for genomic annotations, identifier translation and cross-references. Discover marts, species datasets, attributes and filters before retrieving a bounded result table.
description_zh: 通过 Ensembl BioMart 查询基因组注释、转换标识符并查找交叉引用。可先浏览数据库、物种数据集、属性和筛选条件，再获取查询结果。

description: Find bioRxiv and medRxiv preprints, inspect manuscript versions and publication links, and retrieve category, funder and usage summaries.
description_zh: 检索 bioRxiv、medRxiv 预印本，查看稿件版本与正式发表链接，并获取学科、资助方和使用统计。

description: Explore cBioPortal cancer studies, molecular profiles, samples and clinical data, alongside Sanger Cell Model Passports for cancer models.
description_zh: 浏览 cBioPortal 癌症研究、分子谱、样本和临床数据，以及 Sanger Cell Model Passports 中的癌症模型。

description: Explore CZ CELLxGENE CellGuide cell types, marker genes and tissue context from its published atlas snapshots.
description_zh: 基于 CZ CELLxGENE CellGuide 的图谱快照，浏览细胞类型、标记基因及其组织背景。

description: Search ChEMBL molecules and retrieve compound properties, targets, assays, bioactivities and drug mechanisms.
description_zh: 搜索 ChEMBL 分子，查询化合物性质、靶点、实验、活性数据和药物作用机制。

description: Retrieve chemical identifiers, structures, properties, ontology entries, biochemical reactions and binding measurements from PubChem, ChEBI, Rhea and BindingDB.
description_zh: 从 PubChem、ChEBI、Rhea 和 BindingDB 查询化学标识符、结构、性质、本体条目、生化反应及结合测量数据。

description: Retrieve CIViC variant evidence, ClinGen gene-disease and dosage assessments, and Open Targets target-disease associations.
description_zh: 查询 CIViC 变异证据、ClinGen 基因与疾病及剂量敏感性评估，以及 Open Targets 靶点与疾病关联。

description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov studies and inspect trial eligibility, interventions, outcomes, sponsors and study status.
description_zh: 检索 ClinicalTrials.gov 临床研究，查看入组条件、干预措施、结局指标、申办方与研究状态。

description: Search openFDA drug applications and labeling, filter regulatory records, and summarize selected application fields.
description_zh: 检索 openFDA 药品申请和说明书，筛选监管记录并汇总指定申请字段。

description: Explore GTEx tissue expression and eQTL associations, and query the published PanglaoDB marker-gene snapshot.
description_zh: 查询 GTEx 组织表达和 eQTL 关联，以及 PanglaoDB 已发布快照中的细胞标记基因。

description: Resolve gene and protein identifiers, browse biological ontologies and annotations, and query pathways with MyGene.info, UniProt, OLS, QuickGO, Reactome and KEGG.
description_zh: 通过 MyGene.info、UniProt、OLS、QuickGO、Reactome 和 KEGG 解析基因与蛋白标识符，浏览生物本体、功能注释和通路。

description: Retrieve Ensembl genome annotations, homology, sequences and variants, and inspect UCSC genome assemblies and tracks. Coordinate conventions depend on the selected source.
description_zh: 查询 Ensembl 基因组注释、同源关系、序列和变异，以及 UCSC 基因组组装和轨道。坐标规则取决于所选数据源。

description: Find GWAS Catalog associations, inspect eQTL Catalogue datasets and bounded summary-statistic regions, and query public PheWeb portals.
description_zh: 查询 GWAS Catalog 关联、eQTL Catalogue 数据集及指定区域的汇总统计，以及公开 PheWeb 门户。

description: Search scholarly works through OpenAlex and arXiv, and retrieve publication metadata and available access links.
description_zh: 通过 OpenAlex 和 arXiv 检索学术文献，获取出版元数据和可用的访问链接。

description: Discover experiments, studies and file references in GEO, ArrayExpress, MetaboLights, MGnify and PRIDE Archive.
description_zh: 在 GEO、ArrayExpress、MetaboLights、MGnify 和 PRIDE Archive 中查找实验、研究及数据文件引用。

description: Inspect protein domains and signatures with InterPro/Pfam, tissue and cell annotations from the Human Protein Atlas, and STRING protein associations.
description_zh: 查询 InterPro/Pfam 蛋白结构域与特征、Human Protein Atlas 组织及细胞注释，以及 STRING 蛋白关联。

description: Search biomedical literature, retrieve PubMed records and related articles, convert identifiers, and access available open full text and access metadata through NCBI and Europe PMC.
description_zh: 检索生物医学文献，获取 PubMed 记录和相关文章、转换文献标识符，并通过 NCBI 和 Europe PMC 查询可用的开放全文及访问元数据。

description: Find ENCODE experiments and regulatory data, JASPAR transcription-factor motifs, and UniBind binding-site evidence.
description_zh: 查找 ENCODE 实验与调控数据、JASPAR 转录因子基序，以及 UniBind 结合位点证据。

description: Search antibody records and RRIDs in the Antibody Registry, and discover funding opportunities through Grants.gov.
description_zh: 检索 Antibody Registry 的抗体记录与 RRID，并通过 Grants.gov 查找资助机会。

description: Explore Rfam RNA families, annotations, alignments and covariance models, or submit a bounded sequence search.
description_zh: 浏览 Rfam RNA 家族、注释、序列比对与协方差模型，或提交序列检索。

description: Search RCSB PDB structures, AlphaFold predictions, EMDB maps, Complex Portal complexes and IntAct molecular interactions.
description_zh: 查询 RCSB PDB 结构、AlphaFold 预测、EMDB 密度图、Complex Portal 复合物和 IntAct 分子相互作用。

description: Look up CADD variant scores, gnomAD population frequencies, ClinVar interpretations and dbSNP records.
description_zh: 查询 CADD 变异评分、gnomAD 群体频率、ClinVar 解读和 dbSNP 记录。

description: Find purchasable compounds by ZINC identifier, search similar molecules through SmallWorld, and inspect 3D tranche metadata and download references.
description_zh: 按 ZINC 标识符查找可购买化合物，通过 SmallWorld 检索相似分子，并查看三维分区元数据与下载引用。
